sources.text: This was one of my best days in NYC! Besides the delightful Tiffany’s diamonds, what made my experience special was the care and attentiveness of the people who worked there. Maria was the one who helped me get my first and unique piece. I am so grateful for her amazing energy. Definitely is a place to add in your NYC bucket list. What an amazing once in a life experience! I got two charms I feel so blessed my sales person was so nice ! I got to eat at the blue box cafe wonderful time ! So happy. Angel on the 7th floor so nice with the water ! So happy I got to experience more in the store my second time ! An iconic and elegant destination that truly lives up to its reputation. The renovated space is stunning — refined, modern, and full of timeless charm. The craftsmanship of the jewelry and the attention to detail are exceptional, and the atmosphere feels both luxurious and welcoming. Even if you’re not planning to buy anything, it’s absolutely worth visiting for the experience. And don’t miss the Blue Box Café — it’s a must-visit for a truly memorable and unique New York moment. Well, it was a little tough to find a place.My google kept leading me other places.But we finally made it to tiffany's, in new york.. And believe me, it is what you think.It is a beautiful place with many floors.But everyone seems to be helpful.. Are business was to buy a watch from my girlfriend?And that was accomplished with the help of a salesman named jamie.. One member of our party asked for water, and they brought us all champagne.And some chocolates, very first class service.. Something that i'm not used to.. What made the buying that much more pleasurable..

description.value: Tiffany & Co. The Landmark is the brand's flagship store on Fifth Avenue. Wikipedia notes that the building, at 727 Fifth Avenue, has served as Tiffany & Co. 's sixth flagship store since its completion in 1940. The main store reopened on April 27, 2023, and at that point the store had forty artworks by artists including Damien Hirst and others. It sits on Fifth Avenue at 57th Street in Midtown's luxury shopping district. Representative Tripadvisor praise (search snapshot): “They have exclusive items for sale at this location which does make it special”. Representative watch-outs: “I was a little disappointed in the quality of the workmanship of Tiffany’s pieces”. On Tripadvisor the 727 Fifth Avenue store rates 4.4 Very Good, across 1,354 Reviews.

review1: Tiffany's Landmark store makes milestone purchases feel special, with caring and attentive staff guiding first pieces and turning the visit into a highlight of a New York trip for many.
review2: The Blue Box Cafe and the upper-floor experience are frequent highlights, with friendly staff throughout the building turning a charm or jewelry purchase into a memorable once-in-a-lifetime outing.
review3: The renovated flagship is described as stunning, refined and modern while keeping its timeless charm, and the jewelry craftsmanship and luxurious atmosphere make it worth visiting even without buying anything.
review4: Some visitors find the building hard to locate and a few question jewelry workmanship, but most describe the store as beautiful and welcoming.
